Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps: PrimeBridge Health / Redwood demo follow-up

Hi Ava + Raj,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candid discussion about latency targets and the pilot scope. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks to help move the procurement path along: 

Summary of what I heard:
- Primary use case: clinician-facing summarization + internal analytics (low-latency for UI flows, batch for analytics).
- Key decision criteria: latency SLA, unit cost at scale, and evidence of secure handling for PHI.
- Pilot ask: 3-week proof-of-concept with a 5k-10k daily token volume estimate.

Asks / next steps:
1) Could you share an org chart or quick list of the stakeholders who will be involved in the decision (economic buyer, security, legal, procurement)? A simple file or names/emails is perfect.
2) Any procurement timing or SOW template we should align to?
3) We'll follow up with a tailored pilot SOW and SOC 2 snapshot — I can get you a draft by EOD tomorrow.

Attached: placeholder for demo deck (I will upload the tailored SOW in the follow-up).

If it's helpful, I'd love an intro to your security lead so we can triage the PHI handling questions early.

Thanks — cheers,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

- Success criteria: 95th percentile UI latency under 300ms, generation quality gating against the evaluation prompts you shared, data handling per your controls.
